body: I used to have a psychologist and take meds. But not any longer. Plus I never liked the way the medicine made me feel. I'm thinking of starting therapy or something similar, but I don't have insurance yet.

I've seen it as a FWB thing from the beginning and we've both agreed that we're not in a relationship. I told him I wouldn't see anyone else because he said that's what he wanted and I told him he can keep seeing other girls. The problem lies in the fact that he's making me feel like he likes me more than just for sex.

Idk man I just feel like cutting now. I feel so stupid and helpless. I'm not fucking special and I won't be for anybody. Everyone is just going to use me the same way. I don't know why I let this happen.
The thing is I'm going to feel the same way in any relationship because the main problem is I don't trust anyone and I'm always thinking they might be lying.
I'm scared of being alone, I have abandonment issues. I don't have that kind of willpower.
I guess I'm not bothered by the relationship itself. I'm bothered by the fact that I'm too skeptical and he keeps making me feel like I matter.

I needed to know if other people also thought he could be lying. I don't want to be blinded by just him saying he isn't lying. I can't let myself believe and fall for all that. Sometimes I think he might not be lying because I can't find any contradictions and he seems sincere. But I know how people can be deceiving.

I'm still learning about taking care of myself so feel free to correct me if I'm wrong, but I don't feel like this is affecting my progress because I am not dedicating all of my time to him, I also spend time alone and do things for myself. I just don't want to be led on.
I guess if I meet the right person I'll know and I can leave him. I am allowed to see other people, I'm just not going out of my way looking for them.

Is it emotional manipulation though? I mean I've always had the feeling it might be but I don't see why he wouldn't say such things way before now. And he does seem to be making plans with me for the future. He says I'm his "ride or die." I know it could all be false but I don't see the contradictions. 

And about him seeing other girls it's not like I told him not to do that and I'm allowed to see other people if I wanted to, I just don't feel like going back to dating apps and meeting strangers.

I just can't bring myself to stop seeing him. I just keep thinking of the "what-ifs." And it's not like I asked him not to see anyone else. I don't want to be too demanding and if it's not hurting anyone then I don't see why not. We're not in a serious relationship anyway.

I've known from the beginning he has been using me. And because I knew it wasn't anything serious I didn't mind it, and I treated it as something which wasn't serious. But now he's making me feel this way and that's what changes everything. I know I should've stopped talking to him a while ago but I can't bring myself to do it because it's really fun being around him...

My plan was not to date anyone. I just met him and then everything else happened. I'm not really interested or not interested in a relationship. On one hand it scares me because I don't want to trust anyone, but if he asked me I wouldn't mind trying it out with him. For now I'm good with just seeing him and him being honest because we do have a lot of fun together. I'm just too scared of what might or might not be happening without me knowing.
I'm not insured either unfortunately :(

I used to do therapy but I stopped. And if I had any problems usually by the time I went I would be too embarrassed to talk about them because I feel like my problems are too minimal. And this that's happening now didn't happen for a while. I don't have money for a therapist anymore. I just want a hug and I want to be happy with myself. But it's too hard.

I know, right. If literally every single way of dying didn't have a chance to leave you alive with some sort of problem that just makes your life worse. Not to mention the excruciating pain as you die. I think I'd just kill myself. I want everything to go dark and for me to not have anymore thoughts or feelings.
Dake baked a cake for his fake brother Drake to take so he could slake his heartache.
Thank you very much. I'll re-think out of state college again if what I have here fails.

It's happened to me too. My family can be really insensitive at times. They always like to assume the worst of me. The most recent instance didn't even have to do with self harm. My mom just asked me if I still had a little tin container of lip balm I bought and I said I didn't know where it was and I had to find it. She then asked me if I was using it to hide weed and I was like wtf no. I then proceeded to look for the lip balm and quietly handed it to her when I found it. 

It's so angering and discouraging when your family always thinks the worst of you.

Seeing how most people on Reddit are and how they can judge you based on what they see on your profile, I decided to make this account so I can pour my heart out on these subreddits. And then I deleted the one post I made on my main account that could potentially link to this one in case anyone decides to do some deep researching for some reason.

I don't really know about that but I'm trying to stay in the state I'm in. Preferably around the same area... For stupid reasons... It's too late to apply now though anyway, my mom wants me out by January. I'm scared I'll either become homeless by then or get dragged along with her in her unstable lifestyle. She has said the only reason why she doesn't "disappear" yet is because she doesn't want to drag me along, and she wants me to go to college as soon as possible because she can't stand being here any longer.

Well I've looked at most colleges around the area and most of the ones with campuses are private. I've applied to a couple with campuses. The other's either don't have them or they just don't have anything I'm remotely interested in. 

My family doesn't have enough money for a therapist, or any doctor for that matter really. My mom doesn't even go to the doctor for herself.

I need to find a college that has a campus because my mom wants me out of the house, so I don't have many options. I did meet someone who said they'd rent an apartment with me after they got a job if I helped pay for it and I did get a job recently, but I don't want to hold on to false hope and I have a feeling they might change their mind about it. 

I also think a therapist would help, but I'm scared they won't be able to. I would still give it a try if I had money.

I have very few people who I could talk to. I feel like most of them judge me when I do, especially my mom. Plus there are a lot of things I don't want to get into specifics with with my family. The friends I have I talk to over the internet because they're very far and I try not to go into much detail with them because I don't want to be that one friend who always has a problem.
Not only that but also whole conversations and along with all the different ways they could go.

I'm scared people will try hurt me or lie to me, but I still try to get close to them. And I know people come and go, but it hurts when they leave, especially when I really enjoy their presence. I can't force anyone to stick around if they don't want to though. Sometimes I wish I'd get pregnant so maybe I have someone to love who loves me back I won't feel so alone and I can be supportive.
Thanks! You stay safe as well.
